note: The fourteen templates from DAILY CONTENT/post_templates.txt, as data. A post names one ID. PIPELINE/30-TEMPLATES.md is rendered from this file. Never use the same template two days running, and never invent a fifteenth.
rotation_rules: Never the same template two days in a row.
Mix technical with personal and wisdom in any week.
Every bracket gets a specific detail, never a placeholder.
Every post ends on a statement. The template's closing question is optional and usually cut.

templates.name: Technical deep-dive
templates.use_when: There is a mechanism most readers get wrong and you can show the correct one.
templates.note: The default template for this lane. Fixes the question and ends on a statement.

templates.name: Personal story
templates.use_when: A real thing happened to you and the lesson is carried by the event, not a list.
templates.note: Only with a real event on a real date. No composite stories.

templates.name: Life coaching
templates.use_when: Advice to the reader about how they work, not about the technology.
templates.note: Off-lane. Use sparingly and never in a week with a client deliverable.

templates.name: Leadership lesson
templates.use_when: A decision had a cost and the reasoning transfers.
templates.note: Works when the decision is technical and the lesson is organisational.

templates.name: Faith-inspired wisdom
shape: where it shows up in work
templates.use_when: Only if the owner asks for it. Not a default.

templates.name: Observational insight
shape: what it means for the reader
templates.use_when: The post's value is noticing, not building.
templates.note: Pairs well with a screenshot or a small real artefact.

templates.name: Educational framework
templates.use_when: You have three to five named steps worth remembering.
templates.note: The framework must be yours, not a paraphrase of someone else's.

templates.name: Book lesson
templates.use_when: A specific passage does work that your own words cannot.
templates.note: Quote short, attribute exactly, never at length.

templates.name: Opinion piece
templates.use_when: There is a fight worth having and you can name the other side fairly.

templates.name: Fictional parable
templates.use_when: Almost never. Only when the point cannot be made truthfully any other way.
templates.note: Must be labelled as a story, never passed off as a real event.

templates.name: Behind the scenes
templates.use_when: The work itself is the content and there is a real artefact to show.
templates.note: Best with a run log, a diff, or a screenshot from the actual work.

templates.name: Inspirational narrative
templates.use_when: Milestone posts only, and only with dates and real numbers.
templates.note: Highest risk of hype. Gate on R06 before it ships.

templates.name: Volunteering and community
templates.note: Off-lane unless it is a conference or an open-source contribution.

templates.name: Conversation starter
templates.use_when: You want comments more than reach, and you answer first and honestly.
templates.note: Violates R15 if the post is a bare question with no statement in it. Answer first, then ask.
